name: Can custom kitchen cabinets be designed for aging in place or limited mobility?

mainEntity.name: Can custom kitchen cabinets be designed for aging in place or limited mobility?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, custom cabinets can support aging in place or mobility needs when those requirements are discussed before the layout is finalized. Useful changes may include easier-to-reach storage, clear pathways, accessible work areas, and hardware that is simple to operate.

Context: Accessibility is highly personal and depends on height, reach, mobility, seating, and appliance use. A standard “accessible” package may not suit every household.

Key factors:
- Reach range and preferred work heights
- Clear floor space and turning areas
- Pull-out storage versus deep shelves
- Lever-style or easy-grip hardware

Practical guidance: Identify who will use each work zone and demonstrate any mobility limitations during design. Ask for elevations and reach-sensitive storage locations, not just a list of accessories.

Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate household-specific use requirements into kitchen planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Discuss reach, clear floor space, work heights, pull-outs, appliance access, and easy-grip hardware before design approval. Accessibility should be tailored to the person using the kitchen rather than copied from a generic package.
